subject: mt-info
title: MT.INFO.------CRTF.PROG.
description: Diagram in PCC-23, paired with v1-p339-1. (C)MT-INFO (multi-information) is crossed with CRTF-PROG (cross-transfer progressionalism): the question is what multi-information becomes when its progression is *cross-transfer* rather than source-initiation. MT-INFO → CRTF-PROG (the crossing). Three lines branch from the main line. The first runs to T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and continues as a chain: T-C-IMP → COS-P (cosmic particulars) → VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) → SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). The second runs to TR-INFO (trans-information), from which RE-ST (restructuralism) branches. The third runs to LK-IMP (linkage implications) and continues LK-IMP → INFO-DS (information dissemination) → AFL-DY (affinity dynamics).
